questions.stem: I ____ (read) a book when my friend called me.

options.distractor: 看书是长动作，要用进行时

questions.explanation: 看书是长动作用 was reading，打电话是短动作用 called。

questions.stem: They ____ (play) basketball when it started to rain.

options.distractor: 打球是长动作，要用进行时

questions.explanation: 打球是长动作用 were playing，开始下雨是短动作用 started。

questions.stem: The baby ____ (sleep) when the door bell rang.

options.distractor: 睡觉是长动作，要用进行时

questions.explanation: 睡觉是持续动作用 was sleeping，门铃响是瞬间动作用 rang。

questions.stem: We ____ (watch) the match when someone ____ at the door.

options.distractor: 敲门是瞬间动作，用一般过去时
看比赛是长动作，要用进行时

questions.explanation: 长动作看比赛用 were watching，短动作敲门用 knocked。

options.text: I was having breakfast when the postman came.
She was walking home when it began to snow.
He wrote a letter when the lights were going out.
They were talking when the teacher came in.

questions.explanation: 写信是长动作、停电是短动作，应改为 He was writing a letter when the lights went out。

questions.stem: — I called you at nine, but nobody answered. — Sorry, I ____ (take) a bath then.

options.distractor: “九点那一刻正在洗澡”，要用进行时

questions.explanation: “那时正在洗澡”是长动作，用 was taking，这也解释了为什么没人接电话。
